purpose: Small real public RNA-seq subsets for native-versus-WebAssembly equivalence tests, not accuracy or expression benchmarks.

rna-human.sample: HeLa, HNRNPC knockdown and control experiment
rna-human.source_package_license: LGPL (upstream does not specify a version; package DESCRIPTION preserved)
rna-human.junction_source: Unique N operations and XS strands from selected upstream TopHat2 2.0.8b alignments, shifted to local window coordinates. Observations from these reads, not independent annotations or truth.
rna-human.transformation: Read primary paired alignments in the pinned chr14 BAM. Keep complete pairs whose two alignments fit wholly within hg19 chr14:[102480000,102520000). Sort names lexicographically and take the first 256 pairs. Restore sequence/quality orientation using the SAM reverse flag. Write Phred+33 FASTQ. Extract matching UCSC reference bases, uppercase them and wrap at 60 bp. No read bases or numeric quality scores are modified.
limitations: Reads are recovered from TopHat2 alignments rather than copied from raw sequencer files; prior clipping, quality conversion and processing remain.
The source TopHat command uses --solexa-quals; the fixture preserves numeric qualities from that BAM and emits Phred+33.
Reads were selected for mapping to a narrow window. This cannot establish whole-genome mapping specificity or quantitative expression accuracy.
Human splice hints are derived from the same selected reads. Hint-assisted cases test port equivalence only, not an independent biological prediction.

reference.assembly: S. cerevisiae R64-1-1 (Ensembl iGenomes, as documented by nf-core)
reference.note: Copy upstream reference/genome.fa unchanged. Nuclear chromosome I includes annotated introns.

rna-yeast.junction_source: Consecutive exon features grouped by transcript_id and strand, on contig I of the pinned nf-core reference/genes.gtf. These are existing source annotations, not inferred from our aligner results.
rna-yeast.source_selection_bam: nf-core WT_REP1.sorted.bam produced by STAR 2.7.11b. It also contains SRR6357071; selection explicitly restricts names to SRR6357070.
rna-yeast.transformation: From source BAM, retain complete primary SRR6357070 pairs on I with NH:i:1 for both mates. Divide by whether an N operation matches an annotated intron. Take first 128 names lexicographically in each group. Copy their original untrimmed FASTQ records unchanged from the two pinned nf-core files, in source order. The BAM is used only to choose read names, not to reconstruct sequences or qualities.
limitations: Upstream nf-core enriched reads for chromosome I using Kraken2, then sampled 50,000 pairs with seqtk seed 100; its full procedure is preserved in provenance/nfcore-rnaseq-README.md.
Our further selection enriches for annotated splice-junction reads. It cannot measure splice-junction sensitivity or whole-genome specificity.

Upstream selection BAM contains trimmed reads and some very long apparent introns; our positive splice group requires a junction matching the source exon annotation. Distributed FASTQ reads remain the untrimmed original nf-core records.
No variant, junction or transcript truth set is supplied.

splice_hint_formats.splice-sites.tsv: Tab-separated reference name, zero-based final base of left exon, zero-based first base of right exon, strand; suitable for HISAT2 --known-splicesite-infile.
splice_hint_formats.junctions.bed: BED12, two 20 bp blocks flanking each intron. Blocks encode junction positions only and do not represent complete exon boundaries or asserted transcript models.

provenance_snapshots.rna-human/UPSTREAM_DESCRIPTION.txt: Member RNAseqData.HNRNPC.bam.chr14/DESCRIPTION in pinned source tarball

regeneration.note: Regeneration downloads about 389 MB (mostly the complete Bioconductor data package). Normal tests verify committed compact text files offline. Only rewrite generated files if all expected hashes match.
